name: Mailtrap

evidence.transactional: F02: Email API and SMTP send transactional email
evidence.newsletter: F02: Email Marketing sends newsletters and promotional campaigns
evidence.marketing: F21: automations that send email on contact and API events, with delays and splits

line: Email API, SMTP delivery and a separate email marketing service.

cells.api: Yes, transactional and bulk REST API plus SMTP

subs.math: 4,000 sends to 1,000 contacts. The Essential plan includes 10,000 contacts and 30,000 sends. A verified domain and sending review are required.
20,000 sends to 5,000 contacts. The Essential plan includes 10,000 contacts and 30,000 sends. A verified domain and sending review are required.
40,000 sends to 10,000 contacts. The Pro plan includes 25,000 contacts and 125,000 sends. A verified domain and sending review are required.
200,000 sends to 50,000 contacts. The Pro plan includes 50,000 contacts and 250,000 sends. A verified domain and sending review are required.

appmail.math: 3,000 emails at 100 a day over 30 days fit inside the 150-a-day and 4,000-a-month limits. Production requires a verified domain and approval.
10,000 app emails, one recipient each, fit the Basic 10K plan after verified domain and production approval. Before tax.
50,000 app emails, one recipient each, fit the Basic 50K plan after verified domain and production approval. Before tax.
100,000 app emails, one recipient each, fit the Business 100K plan after approval. The current pricing card includes a dedicated IP. Before tax.
